description.value: Brass Fish Kitchen & Tavern is a grandiose yet earnest pub occupying a prominent space inside Vancouver's iconic Marine Building on Burrard Street in the Financial District. The 3,900 sq ft venue offers a modern pub menu alongside a curated selection of 250+ whiskies, a mezzanine lounge, private dining room, and a small stage with DJ booth. Part of the Freehouse Collective group, it sits among several sister establishments in downtown Vancouver.
